odc_type: improper handling of array class name encoding
observation_summary: The methods returned class names containing JVM internal array encoding characters (e.g., 'String;' instead of 'String[]') instead of the expected human-readable format.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the ClassUtils methods were treating array class names (which follow the JVM internal format like '[Ljava.lang.String;') as standard class names. The code failed to strip the JVM-specific array prefixes ('[') and object type markers ('L' and ';') before attempting to extract the package or short class name. This resulted in the inclusion of these internal characters in the output, causing the observed test failures where 'String[]' was returned as 'String;' and package names were incorrectly prefixed with '[L'.
